_note: Nominal excited-state kinetics for rf_plasma.excited_avalanche. SI units (m^3/s, m^6/s, s^-1). Forms: number; {A,b,c}: A Te^b exp(-c/Te), Te in eV (Maxwellian-fit, evaluated at Te = 2/3 <eps> of the Boltzmann EEDF, a stated limitation); {a300,n}: a300 (Te/300 K)^-n. 'src' cites cases/excited_state_rates.md (labels FT, FT-2 = open secondary compilation, ABS = abstract, DB, CALC = own estimate, UNV = unverified / sensitivity parameter). 'uncertainty' = multiplicative factor used for low/high sets. All three-body coefficients were measured at <= ~1 bar; N^2 scaling at 5-20 bar is unvalidated. Photon 'photo' flags mark radiative decays whose photons exceed the Cu work function (4.65 eV); 'Y' = assumed Cu photoyield (UNV bracket; Feuerbacher & Fitton-type magnitudes) at that photon energy.
